brief:
Ranin Al-Madhoun was offered a place at a German university this month as the new semester begins, but she will not be able to attend, Drop Site News reported. Germany has offered to fund the education of Palestinian students from Gaza, yet the students remain unable to leave the territory to pursue their studies.

The scheme highlights the constraints facing young Palestinians in Gaza, where movement remains restricted despite international educational support programs designed to provide them with opportunities abroad.
dek: This month, as a new semester begins at German universities, students will fill lecture halls to begin their studies. Ranin Al-Madhoun will not be among them.
title: Germany funds Gaza students' education, but they cannot leave the strip
